# Lead memo — Northwind Regional Health ERP pursuit (synthetic, M1 demo)

Quick context before intake runs. We have met the Northwind operations
leadership twice through the regional CIO forum; no incumbent advisory
relationship on our side, and their program office is said to be wary of
vendors who overpromise on go-live dates. The three things they keep
repeating in public sessions: they cannot afford a failed payroll cutover,
their clinical staff have no patience for long classroom training, and the
board wants one accountable delivery partner rather than a consortium.

Our angle: lead with the rehearsed-cutover record and the payroll parallel
runs — transition risk is where this one is won. Keep the support-model
story concrete (named hypercare window, severity ladders), and do not
oversell integration breadth: they only care about the HL7/FHIR interfaces
they already run. Pricing conversations are premature; keep every response
qualitative on commercial terms.
